heading: Funnels, opened up.
intro: Most portfolios show you a hero section and call it a project. A funnel is never one page, so here you get the whole walk. Open any project to see every step a lead goes through, what I designed at each one and why.
footerNote: Most of what I design lives behind a login, inside a community or after someone books a call, so a lot of it never makes it into a portfolio. Ask me and I'll walk you through the rest.

projects.name: IMA Accelerator
projects.oneLine: The full system behind a fast-growing halal business coaching program, from the first ad click to inside the community.
projects.situation: IMA Accelerator teaches people to build influencer marketing agencies, and it is run by Eyoub El Habib. The results and the community were already real. The job was to make every place a lead or a student touches feel like the same serious brand, and to keep building whatever the team needed next.
built: The ads landing page and booking funnel
The selection results page leads see after applying
The pre-call page, split into a short “confirm your call” page at booking and a longer prep page the setter sends
A brand-led homepage that explains the mission, the founder, the community and the program
A coaches platform, a coded app where each coach gets a profile, testimonials, a qualification form and native call booking
Paid playbooks designed as editorial, book-like PDFs
Ongoing SEO implementation on the site

funnel.label: Ad landing page
funnel.note: One idea per screen and a single action. The page is built to be read on a phone in a car park, because that's where most people see it.

funnel.label: Application
funnel.note: Fewer questions, better questions. The form qualifies without feeling like an interrogation.

funnel.label: Selection result
funnel.note: Being “selected” should feel like something. This page turns a form submission into a small moment.

funnel.label: Confirm your call
funnel.note: Shown right after booking with one job only, which is getting the lead to confirm.

funnel.label: Pre-call prep page
funnel.note: Sent by the setter before the call, so the lead shows up warm, informed and already half sold.

funnel.label: Homepage
funnel.note: For people who Google the brand before they pay. It answers “is this legit” without them having to ask.

funnel.label: Coaches platform
funnel.note: Inside the community, every coach gets their own page with booking built in, which quietly turns members into coaching upsells.

funnel.label: Playbooks
funnel.note: Paid products that look like books you'd want on a shelf, not exported slides.

projects.detail: Creating funnels does not simply mean hiding a collection of randomly built pages behind a cool looking 'landing page.' It encompasses the entire ecosystem under a single, consistent brand.
